title: Dinner with dietary needs
es: Pedir, preguntar por ingredientes y resolver un problema en el restaurante
goal: Preguntar por ingredientes, expresar preferencias y necesidades, quejarte con tacto y pagar la cuenta.
phrases: Could we have the bill, please?
I'm afraid this isn't what I ordered.
Me temo que esto no es lo que pedí.

turns.t: Good evening! Welcome to Olive & Ember. Can I start you off with something to drink, and have you had a chance to look at the menu?
turns.es: ¡Buenas noches! Bienvenidos a Olive & Ember. ¿Empiezo con algo de beber? ¿Han podido mirar el menú?

y.say: Yes, thank you. Could we have a jug of water for the table, and I'd like a glass of red wine, whatever you recommend.
y.es: Sí, gracias. ¿Podrían traernos una jarra de agua y yo quisiera una copa de vino tinto, lo que usted recomiende?
alts: Yes please. Can you bring a jug of water, and I would like a glass of red wine, you choose.

turns.t: Certainly. Our house red is a Rioja from a small family vineyard, and it goes very well with the lamb. Are there any allergies or dietary requirements I should let the kitchen know about?
turns.es: Por supuesto. Nuestro tinto de la casa es un Rioja de una bodega familiar y va muy bien con el cordero. ¿Hay alergias o requisitos que deba informar a la cocina?

y.say: Yes, I'm allergic to nuts, and my friend is vegetarian. Does the mushroom risotto contain any nuts?
y.es: Sí, soy alérgico a los frutos secos y mi amigo es vegetariano. ¿El risotto de champiñones contiene frutos secos?
alts: I have an allergy to nuts and my friend does not eat meat. Are there nuts in the mushroom risotto?

turns.t: Good question. The risotto itself is nut-free, but it's finished with a pesto that usually contains pine nuts. I can ask the chef to leave it out, and I'd recommend the grilled sea bass as well, which is naturally safe. The chef is very careful about cross-contamination.
turns.es: Buena pregunta. El risotto no tiene frutos secos, pero termina con un pesto que suele llevar piñones. Puedo pedir al chef que lo omita, y recomiendo la lubina a la parrilla, que es segura. El chef cuida la contaminación cruzada.

c.q: What does the waiter suggest about the risotto?
o: Ask the chef to leave out the pesto

y.say: In that case, I'll have the sea bass, and my friend will have the risotto without the pesto. We'll share some vegetables as a side.
y.es: En ese caso, yo pediré la lubina y mi amigo el risotto sin el pesto. Compartiremos unas verduras de acompañamiento.
alts: Then I will take the sea bass and my friend the risotto with no pesto. We will share some vegetables.

turns.t: Wonderful. I'll bring those out shortly. ... Here you are, the sea bass and the risotto. Enjoy your meal! ... Is everything to your liking?
turns.es: Estupendo. Enseguida. ... Aquí tienen la lubina y el risotto. ¡Buen provecho! ... ¿Todo a su gusto?

y.say: Actually, I'm afraid the fish is a little overcooked, and it's not quite as warm as I expected. Would it be possible to have it replaced?
y.es: En realidad, me temo que el pescado está un poco pasado y no está tan caliente como esperaba. ¿Sería posible cambiarlo?
alts: Actually the fish is a bit overdone and not hot enough. Could you change it please?

turns.t: I'm so sorry about that, I'll take it back at once. The kitchen will prepare a fresh one, and dessert is on the house to make up for the wait.
turns.es: Lo siento mucho, me lo llevo enseguida. La cocina preparará uno nuevo y el postre va por cuenta de la casa por la espera.

y.say: That's very kind of you, thank you. When we're ready, could we have the bill, and could we split it between the two of us?
y.es: Es muy amable, gracias. Cuando estemos listos, ¿nos trae la cuenta y podemos dividirla entre los dos?
alts: Thank you, that is kind. Later can we get the bill and divide it between us two?
